summary: Houthi forces seized Yemen's Perim island and Dhubab city, controlling the Bab al-Mandab strait and threatening Saudi oil exports. Saudi Arabia shut its East-West crude pipeline after drone attacks reportedly launched from Iraq. Israel eliminated Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander and destroyed Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon while preparing for multi-arena escalation during Rosh Hashanah.
key_points: Houthis captured strategic Perim island in Bab al-Mandab and coastal Dhubab, gaining control over a vital global shipping lane for energy trade. (Source: @pkpoi/143919)

Saudi Arabia closed its main East-West crude pipeline following multiple attacks, with one official saying Thursday's strike came from drones originating in Iraq. (Source: @presstv/206417, @Faytuks_Network/7068)
IDF killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abdul Salam Al-Yazouri in an airstrike in southern Gaza overnight. (Source: @manniefabian/59150)

IDF destroyed Hezbollah's tunnel complex beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, killing many operatives and finding around a dozen bodies, with no IRGC presence reported. (Source: @manniefabian/59146)
Iraq permanently closed the Shalamcheh and Chazabeh border crossings with Iran, halting all passenger and goods movement. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90270, @SharghDaily/183181)
Israel raised alert levels for a multi-arena scenario during Rosh Hashanah, with exceptional readiness in the West Bank and north after Hezbollah tunnel destruction. (Source: @pkpoi/143926)
Iran's President Pezeshkian vowed not to bow to US pressure and warned Saudi Arabia, Japan, and Jordan of consequences for their IAEA vote against Iran. (Source: @presstv/206405, @shin_persian/9763)
Next round of Israel-Lebanon negotiations postponed to October due to Jewish holidays, UN General Assembly, and a Paris conference supporting the Lebanese Army. (Source: @SharghDaily/183182)

sections.executive_summary: Houthi forces seized Yemen's Perim island and Dhubab city, controlling the Bab al-Mandab strait and directly threatening Saudi oil exports. Saudi Arabia shut its East-West crude pipeline after drone attacks reportedly launched from Iraq, while Israel eliminated Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander and destroyed Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon. Iraq closed its border crossings with Iran, and Israel braces for multi-arena escalation during Rosh Hashanah.

points: President Masoud Pezeshkian declared Iran will neither surrender nor bow to US bullying, stating Washington seeks to impose its sinister intentions by preventing an independent Iran. (Source: @presstv/206405)
Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson warned that Saudi Arabia, Japan, and Jordan will face consequences for their affirmative votes on the anti-Iran IAEA resolution. (Source: @shin_persian/9763)
CENTCOM claimed to have diverted 99 ships since the start of Iran's maritime blockade, indicating ongoing disruption to commercial shipping. (Source: @SharghDaily/183174)
New evidence presented by Press TV challenges the US account of a deadly strike in Lamerd, with a correspondent reporting from the site. (Source: @presstv/206419)
Turkey closed the Bazargan land border crossing with Iran as of Friday, 20 Shahrivar, according to Iranian border officials. (Source: @mamlekate/104443)

Iran's Foreign Minister and Pakistan's Army Chief discussed renewing diplomatic efforts to de-escalate tensions on all fronts, focusing on US-Iran conflict and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. (Source: @N12chat/226176)

Germany and the UAE issued a joint statement strongly condemning Islamic Republic attacks on the UAE and other regional countries, including strikes on non-military infrastructure. (Source: @kianmeli1/91816)
Itamar Ben-Gvir's Jewish Power party leads among first-time Israeli voters with 18% support, according to Channel 12 polling. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7065)
IDF and Shin Bet eliminated the head of a sniper cell in Hamas's Rafah Brigade, Muaman Gabar Alsaid Abu Labda, in a strike in the Khan Younis area on Thursday. (Source: @idf_telegram/25119)
IDF Southern Command killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abdul Salam Al-Yazouri in an overnight airstrike in southern Gaza. (Source: @amitsegal/64858, @manniefabian/59150)

IDF troops scanned and destroyed Hezbollah's underground tunnel complex beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, killing many of the estimated 50 Hezbollah operatives holed up there and finding around a dozen bodies; no IRGC personnel were present. (Source: @manniefabian/59146)

Israeli defense officials indicate IDF is prepared for a multi-arena scenario during Rosh Hashanah with unusual readiness in Judea and Samaria and the north following the destruction of Hezbollah tunnels and infrastructure at Ali Taher Ridge. (Source: @pkpoi/143926)

The next round of Israel-Lebanon talks, scheduled for this week, has been postponed to October and will be hosted in Rome; ambassadors will meet at the US State Department to discuss framework agreement implementation. (Source: @SharghDaily/183182)

An Israeli source assessed that Houthi control of Bab al-Mandab allows them to visually target ships without sophisticated radar, enabling explosive boat attacks or hijackings, dramatically increasing the terror group's power. (Source: @N12chat/226188)

Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abdul Salam Al-Yazouri was killed in an Israeli airstrike in southern Gaza overnight, confirmed by the terror group and Palestinian media. (Source: @manniefabian/59150)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated the head of a sniper cell in Hamas's Rafah Brigade, Muaman Gabar Alsaid Abu Labda, who conducted sniper training in Gaza to target Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/25119)
Israeli security forces captured two Jericho residents in their 50s at the Jordan border and seized more than 30 pistols and two M-16 rifles. (Source: @inon_yttach/10023)
A man in his 70s drowned near Carmel Beach in Haifa, in moderate condition; not directly conflict-related. (Source: @N12chat/226177)
Israeli defense establishment is preparing for possible escalation in the West Bank during Rosh Hashanah as part of multi-arena readiness. (Source: @pkpoi/143926)
Footage released by IDF shows the moment after the elimination of the Khan Younis Brigade commander. (Source: @N12chat/226181)
A preliminary report indicates a man was moderately injured in Or Akiva; police opened an investigation and are searching for suspects. (Source: @yediotnews25/134921)

IDF destroyed Hezbollah's tunnel complex beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon after troops scanned the underground site; around 50 Hezbollah operatives were believed inside, many killed, around a dozen bodies found, some fled; no IRGC members present. (Source: @manniefabian/59146)

Daily Lebanese monitoring reported 121 total alerts, 71 drone sightings, 10 airstrikes, and 29 artillery shelling incidents on Friday, with Nabatieh al-Fawqa most targeted (12 drone sightings, 3 airstrikes, 7 artillery strikes). (Source: @redlinkleb/42344)
An airstrike hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa, as indicated by a live map alert. (Source: @redlinkleb/42333)

Next round of Israel-Lebanon negotiations delayed to October due to Jewish holidays, UN General Assembly preparations, and a Paris conference supporting the Lebanese Army. (Source: @SharghDaily/183182)
Israeli defense officials cite destruction of Hezbollah tunnels and infrastructure at Ali Taher Ridge as a factor raising escalation concerns in the north. (Source: @pkpoi/143926)
IDF says it will reorganize deployment in the Ali Taher area but maintain control of the ridge with surveillance and firepower. (Source: @manniefabian/59146)

Houthi political bureau member Hazem al-Asad claimed freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab remains safe and operations are defensive, with no intention to charge transit fees. (Source: @N12chat/226189)
Iraq's General Command of Armed Forces ordered the immediate and permanent closure of the Shalamcheh border crossing with Iran, halting all travelers and goods. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90270)

Khuzestan Deputy Governor confirmed Iraq closed both Shalamcheh and Chazabeh border crossings from Friday morning until further notice, stopping all cargo and passenger traffic. (Source: @SharghDaily/183181)
Iraqi families gathered at the Shib border crossing after its closure by the Iraqi government. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90253)
A Saudi official stated that Thursday's attack on the East-West pipeline was carried out by drones originating from Iraq. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7068)
Iraq announced immediate closure of a border crossing with Iran, according to a Hebrew-language security channel. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94352)
Pakistan said no military response was discussed under the Mecca pact regarding Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. (Source: @shin_persian/9762)
A warning issued for residents of Khama, Yemen, to stay off roads as Saudi jets would bomb roads within an hour. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80729)
Saudi Arabia shut down its main East-West crude pipeline after multiple attacks disrupted a key oil export route. (Source: @presstv/206417)

Houthis completed takeover of the strategic Perim (Mayun) island in the Bab al-Mandab strait and seized the coastal city of Dhubab and additional Red Sea coastal areas after Yemeni government forces withdrew. (Source: @pkpoi/143919, @kianmeli1/91807)

Houthi political bureau member Hazem al-Asad stated that freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab is safe, operations are targeted and defensive, and there is no intention to impose transit fees. (Source: @N12chat/226189)
CNN reported Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline was hit by projectiles on Thursday, with one official attributing the strike to drones from Iraq. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7068)
Germany and the UAE jointly condemned Iranian attacks on the UAE and other regional countries, including strikes on non-military infrastructure. (Source: @kianmeli1/91816)
Trump claimed "We control the strait. 'Trump Strait', I call it. We control the Trump Strait!" (Source: @yediotnews25/134918)
Celebrations erupted in Yemen over the victory against Saudi Arabia and the capture of Bab al-Mandab. (Source: @kianmeli1/91815)

key_developments: Houthis seized Perim island and Dhubab city, controlling Bab al-Mandab strait, a critical chokepoint for global oil shipments and trade. (Source: @pkpoi/143919)
Saudi East-West pipeline halted after drone attacks; one official said Thursday's strike originated from Iraq. (Source: @presstv/206417, @Faytuks_Network/7068)
IDF killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abdul Salam Al-Yazouri in southern Gaza airstrike. (Source: @manniefabian/59150)
IDF destroyed Hezbollah tunnel network at Ali Taher Ridge, killing dozens of operatives, finding ~12 bodies, confirming no IRGC presence. (Source: @manniefabian/59146)
Iraq permanently closed Shalamcheh and Chazabeh border crossings with Iran, stopping all trade and travel. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90270, @SharghDaily/183181)
Israel on high alert for multi-arena escalation during Rosh Hashanah, with exceptional readiness in West Bank and northern border. (Source: @pkpoi/143926)
Iran warns Saudi Arabia, Japan, Jordan of consequences for IAEA vote; Pezeshkian rejects US pressure. (Source: @presstv/206405, @shin_persian/9763)
sections.threat_assessment: Houthi control of Bab al-Mandab fundamentally alters Red Sea security, enabling direct visual targeting of vessels and potential disruption of 10% of global trade. Saudi pipeline attacks from Iraqi territory indicate expanding Iranian-backed proxy reach. Israel's simultaneous operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and West Bank preparation suggest a coordinated multi-front campaign. Iraq's border closure with Iran reflects Baghdad's alignment with Gulf security concerns but risks isolating Tehran further. The convergence of these developments raises the probability of a broader regional confrontation within weeks.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are coordinating diplomatically: Germany-UAE condemnation of Iran signals European-Gulf alignment. Pakistan's refusal to engage militarily under the Mecca pact limits Saudi options. Iraq's border closure demonstrates willingness to pressure Iran but may provoke retaliatory proxy actions. The postponed Israel-Lebanon talks indicate diplomatic tracks remain active but are subordinated to military timetables. Houthi assurances on navigation safety are likely tactical to avoid immediate international intervention.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Lamerd strike evidence challenge suggests Iran is building a public case against US/Israeli kinetic actions inside its territory. Turkey's Bazargan closure may be temporary but adds to Iran's land isolation. The IDF's detailed disclosure of Hezbollah tunnel destruction (50 operatives, ~12 bodies, no IRGC) serves deterrence signaling. Houthi acquisition of Perim island provides a permanent base for anti-ship missiles and drones, altering the strategic calculus for any Red Sea coalition. Oil price drop to $109 despite supply threats indicates market skepticism about sustained disruption.
